name: Boba Fett
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Slave I landing gear totem with deployed ramp and scattered bounty pucks
Weathered Mandalorian helmet on spiked trophy stand with glowing green rangefinder
Miniature rocket dart launcher on beskar stand with hanging tracking fobs

factionTrait.name: Duelist Champion
factionTrait.text: A duelist moves the turn token +1 step when they knock out an enemy champion.

uniqueTraits.name: Carbonite Freezing
alternateNames: He's No Good to Me Dead
uniqueTraits.text: When Boba Fett knocks out an enemy champion, remove their banner from the battlefield.

ultimate.name: Seismic Charge
ultimate.text: Remove up to 3 Probe Droids from the battlefield. This skill has +2 {accuracy_die} and +2 {damage_die} for each Probe Droid removed.

plotSkills.name: Jetpack Jump
plotSkills.text: Move Boba Fett up to 1 hex.

plotSkills.name: Deploy Probes
plotSkills.text: The Probe Droids may immediately make a recruit action and may gain a boon of your choice.

clashSkills.name: No Disintegrations
clashSkills.text: This skill has -1 {accuracy_die} for each hex between Boba Fett and his target. Hit Effect: The target gains 1 wound.

clashSkills.name: Flamethrower Blast
clashSkills.text: This skill has -1 {accuracy_die} and -1 {damage_die} for each hex between Boba Fett and his target. Hit Effect: Move target up to 1 hex away from Boba Fett.

traits.name: Rangefinder
traits.text: At the end of the Probe Droids' activation, you may choose a friendly champion adjacent to a Probe Droid model. That friendly champion gains {accuracy_die_boon}.

plotSkills.name: Probe Surveillance
plotSkills.text: You may place each Probe Droid up to 3 hexes from its current hex.

plotSkills.name: Droid Swarm
plotSkills.text: This skill gains +1 {accuracy_die} for each Probe Droid adjacent to the target. Hit Effect: Inflict {protection_blight}.

clashSkills.name: Probe Surveillance
clashSkills.text: You may place each Probe Droid up to 3 hexes from its current hex.

clashSkills.name: Closing In
clashSkills.text: This skill gains +1 {accuracy_die} for each Probe Droid adjacent to the target.
